metadata.notes: Browser-ready Phase 3 seismic artifact set generated from GDR 1141 reprocessed stacks/migrations/velocity products plus GDR 1015 processed 2D stack/depth/velocity products and SEG-P1 navigation. Raw shot gathers remain source/quarantine only and are excluded from active GUI rendering. Legacy L5/L11 products are rendered as section curtains; line placement falls back to the manifest legacy transform/approximation when no delivered SEG-P1 line navigation is present.

layers.label: Utah FORGE Phase 3 MT station locations

metadata.sourceOrigin: Utah FORGE GDR submission 1255 MT EDI station files
metadata.notes: Measured MT acquisition station locations parsed from source EDI LAT/LONG/ELEV headers, converted from NAD83 geographic coordinates to EPSG:26912 / NAD83 UTM Zone 12N, then shifted into GeoSee scene-local meters. Visual marker radius is symbolic for readability; coordinates remain data-derived.

layers.label: Utah FORGE Phase 3 MT resistivity model preview

metadata.sourceOrigin: Utah FORGE GDR submission 1255 updated MT model cell-center inversion package
metadata.notes: Low-resolution preview sampled from the full uncropped updated MT cell-center inversion model. Values are colored by log10 resistivity in Ohm-m. Non-positive resistivity rows are masked because log10 is undefined. This is a validation/presentation preview, not the final sliceable resistivity renderer.

layers.label: Utah FORGE Phase 3 MT resistivity full-density model

metadata.sourceOrigin: Utah FORGE GDR submission 1255 updated MT model cell-center inversion package
metadata.notes: Full-density tiled point-cloud visualization generated from every positive-resistivity row in the uncropped updated MT cell-center inversion model. Values are colored by log10 resistivity in Ohm-m. Non-positive resistivity rows are masked because log10 is undefined. This is the Stage 2 renderer/data-density proof, not a terrain, well, or interpreted geological layer.

layers.label: Utah FORGE Phase 3 MT resistivity slices

metadata.notes: Authored horizontal and vertical resistivity slice preview generated from the full uncropped updated MT cell-center inversion model. Values are colored by log10 resistivity in Ohm-m.
